author: Dyspa
body:
Ok guys so this is like the 3rd map I make but the 1st map I release, the other ones were deleted because of server restart, so whatever, let's go with the map ;D
Name: Hexis
Album: http://imgur.com/JwI9izr,EHCfk4p,qlhWFxJ,5AN9vOY,h0MKqLf,WKXa1bZ,7DpI98X
Size: 20v20
Gamemode: DTM and is meant to be played for the upcoming tourney.
Features: Not much: - Middle island with 5 sets of diamond armor in the middle.
YML: http://pastebin.com/UJLypfBJ
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/rs6142dw0c5oza8/Juano2.rar
Contributors: iMercury and Sethskye, also, thanks ScriptingLyfe or Alex for the server! ;D

Note!: Put your thoughts about the map in the comments so I can fix the mistakes or things you don't like before this map gets accepted/denied.
Thanks!
